title: Viveka-
text: 2. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā- -evam eva kho bhikkhu pañcindriyāni bhāvento-nibbānapabbhāro- kathaṃ ca- -nibbānapabbhāro || || 3. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddhindriyam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || viriyindriyaṃ || satindriyaṃ || samādhindriyaṃ || paññindriyam bhāveti viveka nissitaṃ- -vossaggapariṇāmim || || 4. Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu- -nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro ti || || [page 240] 240 Indriya-Saṃyuttam XLVIII.
